recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves current R6 diff behavior while restoring implementer access from current history to the R3/R4 artifacts that satisfied FHIR-14898.
issue_request: FHIR-14898 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-many and asked for R3->R4 diffs during the STU3-to-R4 ballot cycle because the then-current draft exposed R2 diffs while R3 was the current release. The accepted resolution said the R3/R4 diffs would be included before R4 publication.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied during the R4 cycle by commit 3c3f93c3dae503d0598b2b5abfc927a3a8ea063f, which changed source/diff.html from a DSTU2 comparison to a Release 3/DSTU3 comparison. The published R4 specification now contains the R3/R4 structural difference analysis and companion R3/R4 transform page.
additional_context: Later R5/R6 work repurposed the current diff.html page to compare R4/R4B/R5 with the current R6 build and split current version-specific diff pages. The current build-scope history page still linked the R4 release note's R3/R4 difference analysis to relative diff.html, and build.fhir.org/r3maps.html is not published, so current readers were directed away from the archived R3/R4 artifacts.
reconciliation: Changed source/history.html so the R4 release note links to http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/diff.html and http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/r3maps.html, and clarified that the compare-to-r3 footer link belongs to the R4 publication.
source_changes: source/history.html: pointed the R4 release note's R3/R4 difference analysis and transform references at permanent R4 publication URLs and scoped the compare-to-r3 footer instruction to the R4 publication.

related_jiras.note: R5 corrected diff.html's title from Release 3 to Release 4 after diff.html was repurposed; it helped explain the stale relative link but was already published and not decided here.
